earnings.title: Linde Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: EPS $3.66, down 11%; adjusted EPS $4.59, up 9% YoY
Woking, UK, October 29, 2026 – Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) today reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $1,692 million and diluted earnings per share of $3.66, down 12% and 11%, respectively.
Excluding Linde AG purchase accounting impacts and cost reduction program and other charges, adjusted net income was $2,122 million, up 7% versus prior year.
Sales $9.4 billion, up 9% YoY, underlying sales up 5%
Third-quarter operating cash flow of $3.2 billion, up 8% YoY

quotes.text: Linde’s financial performance continued to improve in the third quarter, with record sales of $9.4 billion and record EPS of $4.59, alongside strong operating cash flow of $3.2 billion.
quotes.by: Commenting on the financial results and business outlook

outlook: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $17.82 - $17.92 representing 8% to 9% growth

For the fourth quarter of 2026, Linde expects adjusted diluted earnings per share in the range of $4.40 to $4.50, up 5% to 7% versus prior-year quarter, with no expected impact from foreign currency translation.
For the full year 2026, the company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $17.82 to $17.92, up 8% to 9% when assuming favorable currency of 2% versus prior year.

Full-year capital expenditures are expected to be in the range of $5.5 billion to $6.0 billion to support growth and maintenance requirements including the $7.9 billion contractual sale of gas project backlog.

items.heading: Weakening economic conditions in markets in which Linde does business may adversely impact its financial results and/or cash flows.
Increases in the cost of energy and raw materials and/or disruption in the supply of these materials could result in lost sales or reduced profitability.

Linde’s international operations are subject to the risks of doing business abroad and international events and circumstances may adversely impact its business, financial condition or results of operations.
Currency exchange rate fluctuations and other related risks may adversely affect Linde's results.
Macroeconomic factors may impact Linde’s ability to obtain financing or increase the cost of obtaining financing which may adversely impact Linde’s financial results and/or cash flows.
An impairment of goodwill or intangible assets could negatively impact the company's financial results.
